ideas.primary_user: Social-care caseworkers filing benefit appeal packs
ideas.painful_workflow: Reconstructing which form version, deadline clock, and evidence checklist applied on the decision date
ideas.current_workaround: Scattered PDFs, email threads, and tribal knowledge in WhatsApp groups
ideas.imported_mechanism: Configuration drift detection + temporal fault trees
ideas.core_computation: Diff official rule versions between decision date and today; emit missing-evidence set required for a valid appeal
ideas.last_mile_action: Generate a dated appeal checklist + filing calendar holds
ideas.visible_transformation: From 2 hours of version archaeology to a dated, auditable appeal pack outline in under a minute
ideas.why_now: Public guidance pages mutate silently; scrapable change histories make drift detectable
ideas.kill_reason: May require careful sourcing of archived guidance pages
ideas.killer_demo: Paste decision date + letter → show guidance diff → emit required evidence list with timestamps
ideas.hard_to_fake_advantage: Auditable version-diff trail with timestamps

ideas.primary_user: Borough planning officers prioritizing inspection slots
ideas.painful_workflow: Manually reordering inspection queues under statutory deadlines and staff sickness
ideas.current_workaround: Spreadsheet with colored cells and hallway negotiations
ideas.imported_mechanism: Constraint optimization with procedural fairness constraints
ideas.core_computation: Solve queue assignment optimizing overdue risk subject to fairness and skill constraints
ideas.last_mile_action: Publish next-day roster + citizen-facing delay notices draft
ideas.visible_transformation: Chaotic board → constraint-satisfying roster with overdue-risk score
ideas.why_now: Open planning datasets + cheap MILP/heuristic solvers
ideas.kill_reason: Solver demo may feel abstract without UX polish | hard-ban topology
ideas.killer_demo: Upload week's applications → show before/after overdue risk and fairness metric
ideas.hard_to_fake_advantage: Numeric optimization delta judges can recompute

ideas.primary_user: Council FOI officers before statutory breach
ideas.painful_workflow: Hunting which handoff stalled a request across teams
ideas.current_workaround: Email archaeology after the breach clock
ideas.core_computation: Infer most likely stalled edge in the process graph from timestamps
ideas.last_mile_action: Create escalation ticket with evidence timeline
ideas.visible_transformation: Blind inbox → pinpointed bottleneck + escalation draft
ideas.why_now: Case logs are exportable; graph reasoning is cheap
ideas.kill_reason: Needs a plausible synthetic log for demo
ideas.killer_demo: Show live clock near breach → highlight failing handoff → draft escalation
ideas.hard_to_fake_advantage: Stateful case timeline with computed bottleneck

ideas.primary_user: Charity finance officers reconciling restricted funds
ideas.painful_workflow: Matching spend lines to grant conditions before audit
ideas.current_workaround: Manual spreadsheet reconciliation
ideas.core_computation: Score spend lines against encoded conditions; surface mismatched allocations
ideas.last_mile_action: Produce auditor-ready exception report
ideas.visible_transformation: Unscoped ledger → ranked exceptions with condition citations
ideas.why_now: Structured bank CSVs + better document parsing
ideas.kill_reason: Document parsing quality risk
ideas.killer_demo: Upload ledger + one grant PDF → red exceptions with citations
ideas.hard_to_fake_advantage: Deterministic reconciliation exceptions

ideas.primary_user: NHS outpatient admin leads
ideas.painful_workflow: Last-minute slot recovery when patients cancel
ideas.current_workaround: Phone blasting waiting list in arbitrary order
ideas.core_computation: Rank call order maximizing fill probability under notice-time constraints
ideas.last_mile_action: Generate ordered outreach list + SMS drafts
ideas.visible_transformation: Random calling → ranked recovery plan with expected fill lift
ideas.why_now: Attendance history is routinely exportable
ideas.kill_reason: Health data sensitivity in live settings
ideas.killer_demo: Simulate 3 cancellations → show ranked backups and expected seats filled
ideas.hard_to_fake_advantage: Scored ordering with simulated fill lift
